question: Who, writing under the pen name Ambai, is a well-known feminist writer and the author of the Tamil novel Andhi Malai?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**CS Lakshmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CS Lakshmi**, writing under the pen name **Ambai**, is a well-known **feminist writer**.
 
• She is the author of the Tamil novel **"Andhi Malai."**
 
• **Ambai's writings** are characterized by their exploration of **feminist themes**, focusing on the lives and experiences of women.
 
• She has made significant contributions to **Tamil literature** and is highly respected for her works.
 
• **CS Lakshmi** has also written several short stories, essays, and critical works.
 
• Her works often emphasize the importance of **gender equality** and address issues related to **identity, freedom, and societal roles.**
 
• She is recognized as a **pioneer in feminist literature** in the Tamil language.
 
• Her contributions to literature have earned her several **accolades and awards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Akka Mahadevi**__

 __
 
• **Akka Mahadevi** was a prominent **Veerashaiva poet and saint** of the 12th century from Karnataka.
 
• She composed **Vachanas**, which are short devotional poems dedicated to **Lord Shiva.**
 
• Her works are known for their profound spiritual insights and **devotional fervor.**
 
 
 
• **Nalapat Balamani Amma**__
 __
 
• **Nalapat Balamani Amma** was a celebrated **Malayalam poet** from Kerala.
 
• She was often referred to as the **"Grandmother of Malayalam Literature."**
 
• Her poetry explored themes of **motherhood, womanhood, and relationships.**
 
 
 
• **Daya Pawar**__
 
 
• **Daya Pawar** was an influential **Dalit writer and poet** from Maharashtra.
 
• His works reflected the struggles and challenges faced by the **Dalit community** in India.
 
• He is best known for his autobiography **"Baluta,"** which is considered a landmark in Dalit literature.
